english.explanation: William Caxton was an English merchant, diplomat and writer. He is thought to be the first person to introduce a printing press into England in 1476, and as a printer to be the first English retailer of printed books. Hence, option (a) is correct.

questions.question_english: The author of Le Morte D'Arthur is:
questions.question_hindi: The author of Le Morte D'Arthur is:
questions.explanation_english: Le Morte D'Arthur is a 15th century Middle English prose reworking by Sir Thomas Malory of tales about the legendary King Arthur, Guinever, Lancelot, Merlin and the Knight of the Round Table, along with their respective folklore. Hence, option (b) is correct.
